close_reason: Already minimized: fetches only query-result IDs with 2-property hint. Full optimization requires a new get_thread_ids backend method.
description: email.rs collapse_by_thread: when collapseThreads=true, the handler first calls query_objects (up to COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS=65536 IDs) then calls get_objects on those IDs to read threadId. For a large account this is 65K IDs fetched from query_objects then 65K objects fetched from get_objects — two full passes through potentially all email. A backend that supports collapseThreads natively (returns pre-deduplicated IDs from query_objects) could do this in one pass. Consider adding a collapse_threads parameter to query_objects, or a dedicated query_collapsed_threads method, so backends can optimize. Current code is correct but will be extremely slow at the COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS ceiling.
title: collapse_by_thread issues a full get_objects fetch for every Email/query
